headcountNote: 20 unique people on the 'Experts, Staff, and Fellows' page across CSR Leadership & Core Staff and its three institutes (Center for Climate and Security, Nolan Center on Strategic Weapons, Converging Risks Lab); people listed under more than one institute counted once with titles joined. Resident Senior/Research Fellows are in-house staff at this think tank and are counted; excluded: 1 Director Emeritus (John Conger), 1 Nonresident Senior Fellow (Kevin Cutright), 1 Research Intern (Rob Mugno). Caitlin Werrell (co-founder, 'Senior Advisor') is counted because the site lists her under Core Staff. Rank prefixes ('CAPT', 'Hon.') dropped from names. The About page's Leadership list also names Christine Parthemore as Director, Nolan Center, but she is absent from the Experts page, so she is not included. Board of Directors is on a separate page and excluded.
